claude.country: Multinational (TEDDY: US and Europe; TrialNet: international, US-led)
models_evaluated: Stratified type 1 diabetes prediction model (genetic risk score, age, islet autoantibodies, family history)

links.outcome: Calibration (Brier score) before and after logistic recalibration in external TrialNet cohort
links.effect: Brier score 0.40 [0.38,0.43] before recalibration; 0.16 [0.14,0.17] after logistic recalibration (p < 0.001); discrimination similar across cohorts (p = 0.14)
links.quote: Adjustment for baseline risk and selection criteria in TrialNet using logistic recalibration improved calibration across all ages (Brier score 0.16 [0.14,0.17]; p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Calibration improvement after recalibrating model to local screening cohort
links.effect: Brier score improved from 0.40 [0.38,0.43] to 0.16 [0.14,0.17] (p < 0.001) after logistic recalibration in TrialNet
links.quote: Adjustment for baseline risk and selection criteria in TrialNet using logistic recalibration improved calibration across all ages (Brier score 0.16 [0.14,0.17]; p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Discrimination and calibration of model in external validation cohort
links.effect: Similar discrimination in autoantibody-positive individuals across TEDDY and TrialNet (p = 0.14), but inferior calibration in TrialNet (Brier 0.40 [0.38,0.43])
links.quote: The combined model showed similar discriminative ability in autoantibody-positive individuals across TEDDY and TrialNet (p = 0.14), but inferior calibration in TrialNet (Brier score 0.40 [0.38,0.43]).
